body_markdown:
Many years ago, this minimalist wedge might have populated in your newsfeed. Perhaps you just scrolled past it, as it was made by United Nude, a company specializing in radical shoes and complimentary accessories. But this isn’t a going concern concentrating on fashion, instead they are famous for applying engineering and architectural themes to their products. This is a distinction with a difference, which manifested into the low resolution concept vehicle presented here.


Designed by United Nude’s founder Rem D. Koolhaas, the[“Lo Res”](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/lv26_r0003/2018-united-nude-lo-res-concept-car) concept car is a low-resolution reinterpretation of Lamborghini’s famous and influential[Countach](https://www.hagerty.com/valuation-tools/search?q=lamborghini+countach) . Not necessarily the later Countach with wings and scoops, but instead that of Marcello Gandini’s clean, original LP 400. The Lo Res concept sports a minimal amount of embellishments on its wedge shaped body, and takes advantage of a modest EV powertrain to alter the design volumes needed for things like an engine bay.


The end result is a vehicle with an even more pronounced wedge shape than the Countach, with a strong “ramp like” feel from nose to tail. It’s less like the Lamborghini, and more like the[Lancia Stratos Zero concept](https://www.hagerty.com/media/automotive-history/lancia-stratos-from-radical-concept-to-all-conquering-rally-champion/) that made its debut in 1970.


Broad Arrow


Lancia Stratos Zero


The Petersen / Ted Seven aka Ted7


Perhaps its wise to consider both the Lamborghini and the Lancia as bookends to the Lo Res concept’s library of minimalism on four wheels. Even better, this is a rare publishing. This Lo Res is chassis #003, which is likely the only finished example created by United Nude. And that’s why its noteworthy to see it surface at Broad Arrow during their[Las Vegas auction](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/lv26_r0003/2018-united-nude-lo-res-concept-car) on Halloween day.


Rich The Kid | YouTube


Rich The Kid | YouTube


But there are very few tricks to the Halloween treat, as this Lo Res was even featured in a music video for Rich the Kid. The video’s producers apparently understood the assignment, as they paired featured artist Kendrick Lamar with another 1970s oddball, the[Bradley GT](https://www.hagerty.com/media/buying-and-selling/bradley-gt-is-gullwing-on-the-cheap/) .


While both cars were never picturized together, the Bradley’s gullwing doors were a nice compliment to the Lo Res’ electronically controlled, tilt-up body. Performing that action exposes a master class in geometric abstraction, as the unveiled interior sports a polygonal steering wheel ahead of cheese wedge shaped seats.


Broad Arrow


Broad Arrow


Like reducing sauce in a saucepan, the Lo Res concept presents the bare minimum needed to operate a motor vehicle. Much of the engineering hardware is still cloaked in secrecy, showing the lengths Koolhaas went to preserve the notion of form over function.


This example of the Lo Res was present at the 2024 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance and in exhibits at the Petersen Automotive Museum. It is a functioning automobile, with motivation from a 5-kilowatt electric motor paired and a single-speed transmission powering the rear wheels. Top speed is around 30 mph, but it is not road legal.


Broad Arrow


Broad Arrow


The inability to drive the Lo Res concept to a local Cars and Coffee is tragic, but the wow factor will likely follow its next owner wherever they may travel. And this car already has stories to tell as it was donated by the Leonardo DiCaprio Foundation to a nonprofit organization called Energy Independence Now. It has lived in the Peterson Automotive Museum since 2020, and resurfaced for the[Wedge Revolution exhibit](https://www.hagerty.com/media/news/petersen-museum-temporary-exhibit-wedge-bmw-3-series/) in 2025.


Broad Arrow


To suggest the Lo Res concept car is an eye-catcher is to damn it with faint praise. This is the embodiment of a vision. It last sold[in 2021 for $111,111](https://bringatrailer.com/listing/2017-united-nude-lo-res/) on Bring A Trailer, and Broad Arrow hasn’t published a presale estimate.


While it’s clear that such a vehicle takes effort to appreciate, it’s likely an easily acquired taste for the passionate fans of United Nude’s mission and product portfolio. The only remaining question is how many of those fans will be present and bidding when it crosses the auction block at the end of this month.
